mission.statement: Ship a restricted-access, invite-only CV-analysis web app that runs an agentic (LangGraph) workflow over the in-repo Base Roadmap via Qdrant RAG, and returns a personalized roadmap that is a strict subset of the Base Roadmap, deployed on free/starter-tier hosting (Vercel + Railway + Qdrant Cloud + Neon).
mission.terminal_signal: End-to-end manual smoke: admin invites a user; user signs in on Vercel; submits CV + description; watches streamed agent progress (SSE); receives Level Resume, Compatibility Score (0-100), and a Personalized Roadmap whose every node_id resolves in the canonical RoadmapIndex. `make test` (lint + typecheck + unit) is green on CI.

goals.title: Monorepo scaffolding & tooling
goals.rationale: Establishes the workspace boundaries and shared orchestration that every later component depends on. Must build before any code component is added.
goals.completion_signal: `pnpm install && make install` resolves; empty `apps/web`, `apps/api`, `packages/shared-types` exist; `make help` lists targets.

goals.title: Frontend foundation (Next.js responsive shell)
goals.rationale: Provides the responsive authenticated shell and Auth.js wiring that all product surfaces mount into.
goals.completion_signal: `pnpm --filter web dev` boots Next.js; `/sign-in` renders responsive layout on mobile + desktop; root `/` redirects to `/sign-in` when unauthenticated.

goals.title: Backend FastAPI skeleton
goals.rationale: Creates the app factory, settings, DTOs and shared TS DTOs that the auth, RAG and agent layers all plug into.
goals.completion_signal: `uvicorn apps.api.src.app.main:app` boots; `GET /healthz` returns 200; CORS + structured logging active; shared-types package exports DTOs.

goals.title: Auth & relational persistence layer
goals.rationale: Enables restricted access: invite-only users in Neon, Auth.js credentials/JWT on the web, and FastAPI JWT verification so the API can trust the session.
goals.completion_signal: Create-user CLI inserts a row in Neon; the user can sign in on the web; a request to a FastAPI protected stub with a valid Auth.js JWT passes and without it returns 401.

goals.title: Base Roadmap data layer + RAG (Qdrant)
goals.rationale: Loads the canonical Base Roadmap, exposes the strict-subset validator, embeds nodes into Qdrant idempotently at startup, and provides the hybrid retriever used by the agent.
goals.completion_signal: On boot, app seed logs 'collection populated: N points'; `RoadmapIndex.is_valid_subset([...])` returns True for real node_ids and False for fake ones; retriever returns ranked nodes for a sample query.

goals.title: Agentic LangGraph layer
goals.rationale: Implements the analysis pipeline: ingest → strip → analyze → compare → level_guess → roadmap_select with the strict-subset guardrail enforced at the final node.
goals.completion_signal: Given a sample CV text + description, the graph streams progress events and returns a structured output whose `personalized_roadmap` is a strict subset of the Base Roadmap; an adversarial input is rejected by the validator with a hard error.

goals.title: Integration, product surfaces & deployment
goals.rationale: Wires the annotated endpoint and SSE stream into FastAPI, persists analysis records, builds the three frontend surfaces, and adds container + Vercel/Neon/Qdrant deployment config and docs.
goals.completion_signal: Manual smoke matches the Mission terminal_signal; `apps/api/Dockerfile` builds; `apps/web/vercel.json` valid; `.env.example` lists every var named in SDD §11; README documents the deploy.

goals.title: Fix Staff roadmap parsing and content separation
goals.rationale: The GROUP_PATTERN regex in archive_parser.py silently drops every Staff group from all 3 roadmaps (group_count=0) due to mandatory whitespace before ** when no level suffix exists, and the Frontend Staff ownership literal (duplicado) is unrecognized. This also silently drops some non-Staff groups without a suffix (e.g. backend Cloud Fundamentals). Fixing this ensures Staff-level nodes exist in RoadmapIndex and Qdrant for scoring and retrieval.
goals.completion_signal: Running the parser against all 3 archives produces staff/level.json with group_count=3 for software_engineer and ai_engineer, and group_count=0 (intentional) for frontend_engineer. Staff nodes appear in Qdrant after re-seed. Existing Pleno/Senior groups are unaffected.

goals.title: Make experience-derived competencies count via embedding similarity
goals.rationale: compare_node classifies nodes as covered/known_via_experience/gap via exact string equality only. Since RoadmapNode.aliases is always empty and user CV terms (especially from English LinkedIn exports) never literally match Portuguese roadmap node names, experience-based competencies silently fall through to gap. This makes the compatibility score ignore real experience and the analysis report incorrectly flags mastered skills as gaps.
goals.completion_signal: Given a CV mentioning 'reduced cloud costs by 30%', the node 'Otimização de custo vs performance' is classified as known_via_experience, not gap. English terms from LinkedIn exports also trigger known_via_experience. False positive rate ≤ 5% on a 20-node test set.

goals.title: Force Portuguese-only analysis output (API scope)
goals.rationale: The agentic analysis pipeline produces English output for level_resume (summary/strong_points/weak_points), matched_node reason strings, and fallback career_summary — even when the CV input is English Portuguese should be the output language per user requirement. The LLM prompt itself stays in English (extraction quality), but all user-facing output must be Portuguese.
goals.completion_signal: Running the full pipeline with an English CV CSV export produces Portuguese level_resume.summary/strong_points/weak_points, Portuguese matched_node.reason strings, and Portuguese fallback career_summary. Existing tests pass.

goals.title: Fix compatibility score using full target roadmap + unify gap selection
goals.rationale: The compatibility score denominator is built only from RAG-retrieved nodes (seeded by the user's own skill terms), not the complete target role+level node set from RoadmapIndex.by_role_level(). True gaps are invisible because they're never queried. This structurally inflates the score (users with partial CVs get non-zero scores for roles they know nothing about). The personalization gap list in roadmap_select also uses the same biased partial set, missing entire categories of gaps.
goals.completion_signal: A user with zero skills for a target role gets compatibility_score=0. A user with all target skills gets 100. The personalized roadmap contains ALL true gap nodes, not just nodes semantically close to claimed skills. Unit tests for _compute_compatibility_score pass.

tasks.title: Add Base Roadmap Pydantic models, loader and RoadmapIndex (incl. validator)

tasks.acceptance_test: Loading parses all docs/archives/*.json; `RoadmapIndex.is_valid_subset(['valid-id'])` is True; `is_valid_subset(['fake-id'])` is False; reverse lookup by role+level+category returns expected nodes.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Pydantic models: RoadmapFile, RoadmapNode (id, name, type, category, level, importance, aliases, requirements_by_level, content_guidance, interview). Loader builds RoadmapIndex keyed by node_id with reverse lookup by role+level+category. Validator is_valid_subset(node_ids) is the single source of truth for the strict-subset rule (ADR-008).

tasks.title: Add Qdrant client + embedding service interface
tasks.rationale: Connection + embedding abstraction the seeder and retriever depend on; lets the embed model be swapped later.
tasks.acceptance_test: Unit test mocks Qdrant Cloud and embedding model; the embedding service returns fixed-length vectors; the client exposes async upsert/search wrappers.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Client: qdrant-client async, pointing at Qdrant Cloud. Embeddings: text-embedding model (configurable; default text-embedding-3-small or local fallback) behind an interface so model can change.

tasks.title: Add idempotent startup seeder + lifespan wiring
tasks.rationale: Implements ADR-006: collections are populated from Base Roadmap on boot iff empty, so a re-deploy cannot drift.
tasks.acceptance_test: On a fresh collection, booting the app embeds and upserts every Base Roadmap node with payload {role, level, node_id, category, importance, name, description, content_guidance}; a second boot is a no-op (point count matches).
tasks.sdd_snippet: Startup seeder (ADR-006): idempotent — if collection point count == 0, parse Base Roadmap via C-DATA, embed each node's name+description+topics, upsert. Otherwise skip. Collection roadmap_nodes with payload {role, level, node_id, category, importance, name, description, content_guidance}.

tasks.title: Add hybrid retriever with role/level filters
tasks.rationale: Returns ranked Base Roadmap nodes for the agent's compare node; constrained to roles/levels via metadata filters.
tasks.acceptance_test: A test query with filters `{role: software_engineer, level: senior}` returns only matching node_ids, ranked by relevance, top-k configurable.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Retriever: hybrid search (dense vector + sparse keyword/alias match) with filters {role, level}; returns candidate RoadmapNodes ranked by relevance. Tunable top-k.

tasks.title: Add AgentState schema + ingest + strip nodes
tasks.rationale: Defines the shared graph state and turns raw CV bytes + description into clean text all later nodes consume.
tasks.acceptance_test: Given bytes for a small PDF/DOCX/TXT + text description, the strip node populates `raw_cv_text` and `raw_description` on state; ingest asserts the file is ephemeral.
tasks.sdd_snippet: State schema: AgentState { user_id, raw_cv_text, raw_description, extracted_skills, matched_nodes, level_estimate, compatibility_score, personalized_roadmap, errors }. Node ingest stores bytes ephemerally; node strip extracts clean text from PDF/DOCX/TXT.

tasks.title: Add analyze node (structured skill extraction)
tasks.rationale: Maps the user's CV/description into structured skills/tech/experience for comparison.
tasks.acceptance_test: On a sample CV, the node returns a structured `extracted_skills` object via a typed LLM tool-call; malformed output raises a validation error rather than passing silently.
tasks.sdd_snippet: analyze — LLM tool-call with structured schema: extract skills, technologies, years of experience, domain areas.

tasks.title: Add compare node (retriever-backed gap analysis)
tasks.rationale: Bridges agent and RAG: identifies which Base Roadmap nodes are covered vs gap areas.
tasks.acceptance_test: Given mock `extracted_skills`, the node calls the retriever, classifies coverage, and writes `matched_nodes` + gap list onto state.
tasks.sdd_snippet: compare — call C-RAG retriever for relevant Base Roadmap nodes matching extracted skills; identify gaps.

tasks.title: Add level_guess node (seniority + compatibility score)
tasks.rationale: Produces the user-facing Level Resume inputs: seniority estimate, trajectory narrative, and 0-100 score.
tasks.acceptance_test: Given mock matched/gap nodes, the node returns one of {junior, mid, senior, staff}, a narrative string, and a `compatibility_score` in [0,100].
tasks.sdd_snippet: level_guess — estimate seniority (junior/mid/senior/staff) + trajectory narrative; compute compatibility_score (0-100).

tasks.title: Add roadmap_select node + strict-subset guardrail + graph wiring + SSE mapping
tasks.rationale: Final node: selects the personalized subset, validates every id against RoadmapIndex, wires all nodes into the LangGraph, and emits progress events consumable by SSE.
tasks.acceptance_test: Running `graph.run(...)` on a sample CV streams one progress event per node and returns a result whose `personalized_roadmap` nodes ALL pass `RoadmapIndex.is_valid_subset`; injecting a hallucinated id forces a re-plan then a hard error.
tasks.sdd_snippet: roadmap_select — select subset of nodes addressing gaps/next steps; emit personalized_roadmap. Strict-subset guardrail (ADR-008): final node validates every selected node_id via RoadmapIndex.is_valid_subset. Invalid → re-plan once with a corrective prompt, then hard-error. NEVER emit hallucinated nodes. Stop criteria: max iterations (e.g., 6), structured-output validator passes. Streaming: LangGraph state events map to SSE AgentProgressEvent payloads.

tasks.title: Add FastAPI POST /analyze + SSE stream endpoint and history persistence
tasks.rationale: Turns the LangGraph runner into the public, auth-protected, persisting API the frontend consumes.
tasks.acceptance_test: Calling `POST /analyze` (authed) returns 201 + analysis_id; `GET /analyze/{id}/events` streams progress then final result via SSE; a row in `analyses` transitions running→done; an unauthed call returns 401.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Endpoints: POST /analyze (multipart DTO §6, echoes 201 with analysis_id, begins streaming agent progress); GET /analyze/{id}/events (SSE stream delivering node-progress events + final result DTO). FastAPI verifies the Auth.js JWT; protected endpoints reject unauthenticated requests with 401. Persist analysis record (input + output + node IDs) to Neon Postgres.

tasks.title: Add frontend input form surface

tasks.sdd_snippet: Three product surfaces: (a) input form (name/phone/email/description/CV file upload) → POST to /analyze. Typed fetcher hitting FastAPI SSE endpoint; DTOs synchronized from packages/shared-types.

tasks.title: Add frontend progress + results surfaces (SSE consumer)
tasks.rationale: Second and third surfaces: drives the streaming progress UI and renders the verified result.
tasks.acceptance_test: A visited `/analyze/{id}` subscribes to the SSE stream, renders each AgentProgressEvent, then renders Level Resume, Compatibility Score and Personalized Roadmap list on the terminal event; responsive on mobile + desktop.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Surfaces: (b) streaming progress / loader, (c) results view (Level Resume, Compatibility Score, Personalized Roadmap). DTOs from packages/shared-types.

tasks.title: Fix GROUP_PATTERN regex whitespace in archive_parser.py
tasks.rationale: The `\s+` before the optional level-suffix group is mandatory, causing all Staff group headers (no Básico/Intermediário/Avançado suffix) to fail regex matching. Fix by making the whitespace part of the optional non-capturing group.

tasks.sdd_snippet: ArchiveParser.GROUP_PATTERN: regex must parse all group header formats including Staff groups with no level suffix.

tasks.title: Handle duplicado ownership marker and regenerate data/roadmaps
tasks.rationale: Frontend Staff groups use `*(duplicado do Software Engineer — Sênior)*` ownership which the parser doesn't recognize. Map this to ownership='referencia' with reference_target='software_engineer, senior'. Then regenerate all data/roadmaps/ and verify Staff group_count for backend=3, ai-engineer=3, frontend=0 (intentional).
tasks.acceptance_test: Running the parser on roadmap-frontend-indice.md records Frontend Staff as reference (0 own groups) referencing software_engineer/senior. Running on roadmap-backend-indice.md parses 3 Staff groups with 7-8 skills each. All Pleno/Senior groups unaffected.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Group ownership 'duplicado' mapped to 'referencia' with reference_target pointing to the source role+level.

tasks.rationale: Once compare_node classifies the complete target node set (T11.1), level_guess_node's weighted score using state.matched_nodes automatically computes correctly against all target nodes.
